tei:div.tei:p: ya bzhi'i dbang bzhi klong snying ltar rtsa gsum chos skyong la phug gtor cha tshang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyan sogs gzhung mthun bsham/ bla ma yang tig la/ brgyud 'debs/ tshogs mchod yid bzhin rgya mtsho la/ bla ma yid nor sbrel bsnyen/ dbang gzhung bsnyen/ las bum rdor sems sgrub/ khrus/ bgegs gtor/ lo rgyus chen mo/ maṇ+ḍal tshogs gnyis sprin tshogs/ dbang gzhung gsol 'debs nas/ byin 'bebs dmigs pa la/ 'og gi rtsa tshig rnams sbyar/ byin 'bebs dbyangs bcas ḍa ru 'khrol/ tshig mtshams phyir rdeg re/ mthar 'ur/ dbang gzhung nag 'gros/ mthar tshogs rdzas 'dod yon/ shis brjod grol/ spros med dbang bshams sgrub/ khrus/ bgegs/ sems sbyong bdun pa'i don khrid/ gzhung tshig dang bstun/ na rag skong bshags nam 'don la slob ma rnams langs te phyag 'tshal ba rgyun du dgos/ maṇ+ḍal kun bzang chos spyod ltar/ yang na zab mo yang tig ltar/ 'jug pa gnyis kyi mtshams ye shes dbab pa sbyar/ mthar khregs chod don khrid/ tshogs/ bkra shis/ shin tu spros med spyod pa brtsam pa dang*/ dngos gzhi 'od gsal snying po'i don khrid sngon 'gro gnyis lto sbyar te bshad/ ri khar khrid sbyong gtang*/ dbang gzhung nas/ gzengs bstod mgor/ khregs chod (504) khrid/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi rgyan gyur/ rab tu spros med dbang bshams bskur gzhung ltar/ maṇ+ḍal lnga tshan chung ba/ dbang bzhi la maṇ+ḍal so so bzhi yod pa dbang re re'i nang du maṇ+ḍal du dgos/ rang skal maṇ+ḍal re bskyar dgos/ gzengs bstod la/ thod rgal khrid mthar dbyung*/ tshogs zhus bcas/ tshogs mchod/ lhag rol/ lhag ma bcas/ btags grol sgrub/ thig le nyer lnga re re bzhin tshar nyer gcig re phyag lnga tshan/ bi ma snying thig gi sangs rgyas sras gcig tshar gcig dbang gzhung ltar/ bkra shis/ bsdu rim/ bsngo ba bcas so// ༈ bi ma snying tig dang zab mo yang tig bcas de'i 'grigs ji bzhin 'don dgos/ dmigs gsal zab mo yang tig la/

gsol 'debs bī ma'i bla sgrub/ dbang gzhung sgrub/ khrus/ bskrad/ lo rgyus chen mo/ dbang bskur lugs gong dang 'dra/ byin 'bebs ma sbyar na chog khrid rnams mi dgos/ 'di la tshogs med pas tshogs rgyas pa nam dgos skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu mdzad/ 'di rnams bla slob rten 'brel 'dzoms na/ nyin re dbang sne re bskur/ snga thun phyi thun rnams la slob ma rnams ru shan sbyangs/ nang nub yig brgya dang*/ 'bru gsum bsag bla ma khrid sbyong la phebs na dang*/ min tshe/ gzhung gsal bsnyen tshad re 'grub nges mdzad pa las/ gter mdzod lta bu sbrel ma dgos na shin tu legs/ gsang skor gtor dbang sgrub/ ye shes sku mchog= (505) lo rgyus snyan brgyud/ bar ma la lag len/ gtor dbang*/ rtsal dbang bcas/ mchog gsang lam khrid tsam bshad/ btags grol bsgrubs nas/ dbang gzhung ltar/ bkra shis/ dam tshig sogs tshogs rgyas par gtang*/ bi ma snying thig de ltar la/ bi ma'i bla sgrub spros bcas dbang lce btsun gyis mdzad pa ltar sgrub tshul bla ma yang tig bzhin/ lo rgyus chen mo gong 'og gnyis ka sbyar/ karma pa rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dbang gong ma gsum/ btags grol dbang tshogs bla ma yang tig ltar mdzad/ maṇ+ḍal/ 'di yan chod gsum la bla ma yang tig ltar dgos/ ༈ mkha' 'gro yang tig la/ las byang mkhan rdo rje 'chang rin po che'i bsgrigs ma ltar/ mkha' 'gro sbyar/ bstod pa mgor sngags 'bul/ bsnyen pa/ dkyil 'khor dbus kyi mar me rnams sbar/ khrus/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/ yig brgya nyer gcig mgon po 'od zhu/ thod phreng rtsal dmigs bzlas/ zhi khro'i lha bskyed/ 'og gi sta gon ltar rgyas par blang*/ spyan 'dren man lhag 'don nam/ rjes zlos/ bshags pa yan/ ye shes sku mchog= tshar gsum/ na rag skong bshags/ ye shes sku mchog= ru tra'i smre bshags/ dus gsum bde gshegs= mkha' 'gro'i brda dbang*/ tshogs rdzas 'dod yon=

rim bzhin/ dam tshig sbyin/ mar me bsal shul/ sa lha'i tshom bu/ dkar bgegs bsham/ sa slong sbyong bzung rnams lhag chad med par rgyas par gtang*/ lha tshom lnga tsam 'gaud/ bum pa/ bkru (506) bran/ bdug bum rdzas blugs ste bsgrub/ gzungs thag bcas/ las bum dus las bum la sbrel/ mchod bstod 'od zhu/ ras bris bting*/ mdun bskyed rgyas par/ gsol gdab pus mo g.yas 'dzugs/ g.yon bslang*/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rgyas par/ slob ma sta gon zhag chod mdzad/ dngos gzhi la/ mkha' 'gro'i las byang*/ bsnyen pa/ rigs lnga'i las byang*/ bdag 'jug pad+ma klong yangs nas sgo rgyab/ khrus/ mig dar/ me tog zhu lam/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor/ sgo zhus nang du 'khod/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun/ sa gzhi= lan bzhi/ lo rgyus chen mo sbyar/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun nas/ bum dbang yongs rdzogs/ tshogs rdzas/ gsang dbang cha tshang tshogs/ sher dbang yongs rdzogs/ 'di rnams gzhung tshig gsal bar/ yi ge che chung rnams nar 'don lta bus/ gzhung gis dngos bstan yod rigs lag len bcas chad lhag med pa dang*/ shin tu dal chags pa slob ma go brda re 'phrod nges gal che ma gtogs deng sang dbang thob grangs dang zhus grangs tsam las/ dbang don ye shes 'di skye med pa tha na dbang gi 'gros la go ba dmigs rim 'di 'dug tsam yang blo la nges med rgyu byas la ma bsags pa de lta bu sngags kyi bstan pa nub la nye bas bla slob kun nas nan chags chos la mdzad/ re zhig 'jig rten pa'i bya ba che bzhag chung bskyur gyis dbang bskur thob go chod nges mdzad pa gal che che/ tshig dbang rin po cher/ me long gi sngags bkru/ sman mchod/ dam tshig gi gzugs me long la zhi khro shar ba/ sba dbyug rtser dril bu btags pa sogs ngo sprod re (507) re bzhin/ tshogs bcas/ ka dag rtsal dbang thod pa brje/ na rag skong bshags tshang ma/ byin 'bebs sngags re ḍā 'ur/ tshogs/ thod rgal/ rtsal dbang*/ tshogs/ mkha' 'gro don gyi dbang la/

e ma ho/ngo mtshar= tshar lnga gsang snying ltar/ tshogs bcas/ 'di man 'don srol mi 'dug nges don snying po'i khrid kyi dbang dang*/ khrid bcas gzhung gsal/ 'di yi btags grol dbang*/ mkha' 'gro snying thig mjug tu bskur srol yod/ bkra shis/ dam tshig maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas= bsngo ba/ tshogs mchod rgyas par gtang*/ ༈ mkha' 'gro snying tig la/ de'i 'gres kyis 'gro dgos pa spyir btang*/ dmigs bsal dbang sgrub/ mkha' 'gro'i las byang*/ lhag ma/ bskul pa bcas/ rigs lnga phyi sgrub la brten nas/ sa chog nas/ lha sta/ bum sta/ sbyin sreg rnams dgos kyang*/ dbang gzhung*/ khrus bskrad nas/ lo rgyus gter gzhung*/ gang legs gcig maṇ+ḍal/ dbang gzhung*/ yig chung nas nar 'ded kyis gsungs/ gzhung gi tshig zin ltar/ sta gon dgos rigs rnams kyang mthar chags chad lhag med pa btang nas re re bzhin rtsa tshig 'di'i dgongs pa yin zhes slob mar go brda sprad/ slob ma sta gon kyang de'i nang ltar mdzad/ zhag chod ma mdzad na/ logs la mdzad/ dbang gzhung nar 'ded kyis/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod rigs lnga phyi sgrub/ las byang*/ mchod 'bum/ re re bzhin/ zur gsal rnams skabs der sbyar nas mdzad/ dbang (508) dngos kyang de ltar la/ byin 'bebs/ chos dbyings gsal mdangs/ dkyil 'khor rnam dag zur pa rnams sbyar/ me tog mgor bzhag rjes/ bskyed pa lha/ bzlas pa sngags/ rdzogs rim rigs lnga'i sgrub pa ltar khrid btab/ dam chu nam dgos nang mchod kyi mdzad/ bum dbang yongs rdzogs zin nas/ tshogs khrid gdab pa nas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rgyas par gtang*/ mchog dbang gong ma gsum la tshemapa 'dra min ya zung yod kyang*/ mgo mtha' tshang ba can de rtsa ba mdzad/ sa ma 'grel lta bu gcig dang po gsung*/ maṇ+ḍal/ gsol gdab/ dmigs pa rgyab yig sbyar/ ngo sprod skabs lhan thabs ngo sprod/ de'i 'gres kyis sher dbang la sa bcad/ gzhung lhan thabs sbrags/ brgyud 'debs dngos med mtha' bral/

dbang bzhi par/ sa ma 'grel/ rta mgrin sgom pas tshog ma ldeb gnyis des bya/ bsnyen pa mthar chags bskyar/ rtsal dbang rtsa ba dang 'grel pa sbrags/ khyad par dbang lnga/ mngon sum rtsal dbang*/ gsol 'debs dngos med mtha' bral/ rigs lnga mkha' 'gro ngo sprod sogs dus shel rdo 'phyar/ thod rgal ngo sprod skor thams cad/ btags grol dbang mkha' 'gro yang tig rgyud drug gzhung ltar/ shis brjod/ dam tshig maṇ+ḍal/ tshogs 'gyed lhag ma man/ srog sgrub ma'i srog gtad gzhung ngam/ gter mdzod ltar (509) 'dod bum nas blang*/ gnod sbyin/ sde bdun/ gtso rkyang sogs dgos tshe kun mkhyen gsung ltar ram/ 'dod bum ltar yin/ 'di rnams don gnyer yod nges nyams len gzhol nges can la gsung rgyu gal che che/ lung gi skabs dal la snyan chags pa rang gi yang go ba lon nges res gsungs na thugs phan che/ bi ma snying thig nang rnam thar skor rnams dzaḥsprul brgyud par mi bzhugs kyang mkhyen brtse'i brgyud par lung snang bas mkhan rdo rje 'chang las nged nas zhus te kun la bton pa yin lags/ 'di skabs bskang bshags dang*/ klong snying gsol kar gzab dgos lags// dge'o//
